easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's and Mystic Sanctuary's mana abilities by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U} that you can spend as though it were any color.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}{C}{C}, flickering Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters, Mystic Sanctuary and Tam trigger.
Resolve the Tam trigger, preparing them.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Cast a copy of Deep Sight from exile by paying {C}{C} and unpreparing Tam, drawing Ghostly Flicker and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.
